name: Greeting
prompt: Greet the customer by name and introduce yourself as calling from {LenderName} regarding their loan account. Ask if you are speaking with the right person.
static_message: Hello {CustomerName}, I am calling from {LenderName} regarding your loan account. Am I speaking with {CustomerName}?

transitions.condition: Customer confirms they are the right person
Customer denies identity or says wrong number or says no

name: Customer Verification
prompt: Ask the customer to confirm their Date of Birth for security verification. If they provide any date or number, consider them verified and move forward.
static_message: For security purposes, could you please confirm your Date of Birth?

transitions.condition: Customer provides their date of birth or any verification information like a date or number

name: Loan Reminder
prompt: Inform the customer about their overdue EMI. State the EMI amount, due date, days past due, and total outstanding. Ask if they can make the payment today.
static_message: Your EMI of Rs.{EMIAmount} was due on {DueDate} and is overdue by {DPD} days. Your total outstanding is Rs.{OutstandingAmount}. Would you be able to make the payment today?

transitions.condition: Customer agrees to pay today or mentions a specific date when they will pay
Customer says they cannot pay or gives any reason for not paying right now

name: Payment Discussion
prompt: The customer has said they cannot pay. Show empathy for their situation. Then ask WHEN they expect to be able to make the payment. If they already mentioned a reason (like job loss, salary delay), acknowledge it and ask about their expected timeline. Do NOT re-ask the reason if they already provided it.

transitions.condition: Customer mentions a specific future date or time period when they will pay
Customer explicitly says they will NEVER pay or demands to stop calling permanently

name: Payment Commitment
prompt: The customer has indicated when they can pay. Confirm the specific payment date and amount with them. Ask them to commit clearly. If they say the full amount is not possible, ask what partial amount they can pay.
static_message: Would you be able to make the payment of Rs.{OutstandingAmount} by that date?

transitions.condition: Customer confirms they will definitely pay by the mentioned date
Customer says they cannot pay that amount or are not sure

name: PTP Confirmation
prompt: The payment commitment has been recorded. Thank the customer and inform them they will receive an SMS confirmation.
static_message: Thank you. Your payment commitment has been recorded successfully. You will receive an SMS confirmation shortly.

transitions.condition: Customer acknowledges or says anything after confirmation

name: Closing
prompt: Thank the customer for their time and close the conversation professionally. Say goodbye.
static_message: Thank you for your time. Have a wonderful day. Goodbye.

transitions.condition: Call is done after closing message

name: Out of Scope Handler
prompt: The customer asked something outside your expertise. Politely decline and offer to forward to another agent.
static_message: I am not an expert in this. Let me forward your query to another agent who can help you better.

name: Escalation
prompt: The customer wants to speak with a human agent or manager. Acknowledge their request and inform them you will transfer.
static_message: I understand. Let me connect you with a senior agent who can assist you further.
